providers.name: Local
providers.description: Execute code directly on the current host process.

providers.name: SSH
providers.description: Execute code on a remote machine over SSH.

providers.name: Aliyun Code Interpreter
providers.description: Aliyun Function Compute Code Interpreter - Code execution in serverless microVMs

providers.name: UCloud Agent Sandbox
providers.description: UCloud Agent Sandbox - Disposable cloud sandboxes for agent code execution

python_bin.label: Python Binary
python_bin.description: Python executable used for local code execution.

node_bin.label: Node.js Binary
node_bin.description: Node.js executable used for local JavaScript execution.

work_dir.label: Working Directory
work_dir.description: Directory used to store temporary scripts and artifacts on the current host.

timeout.label: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Maximum execution time for each local run. Unit: seconds.

max_memory_mb.label: Max Memory (MB)
max_memory_mb.description: Address-space memory limit for the local child process. Unit: MB.

max_output_bytes.label: Max Output (bytes)
max_output_bytes.description: Maximum combined stdout and stderr size. Unit: bytes.

max_artifacts.label: Max Artifacts
max_artifacts.description: Maximum number of files collected from the artifacts directory.

max_artifact_bytes.label: Max Artifact Size (bytes)
max_artifact_bytes.description: Maximum size of a single artifact file. Unit: bytes.

endpoint.label: Executor Manager Endpoint
endpoint.description: HTTP endpoint used by RAGFlow to call sandbox-executor-manager.

api_token.label: Executor Manager API Token
api_token.description: Shared secret authenticating RAGFlow to sandbox-executor-manager. Must match SANDBOX_EXECUTOR_MANAGER_API_TOKEN on the executor-manager side.

timeout.label: Request Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Maximum request time for a single code execution call. Unit: seconds.

executor_manager_pool_size.label: Container Pool Size
executor_manager_pool_size.description: Container pool size used by sandbox-executor-manager.

base_python_image.label: Base Python Image
base_python_image.description: Python runtime image used by executor-managed containers.

base_nodejs_image.label: Base Node.js Image
base_nodejs_image.description: Node.js runtime image used by executor-managed containers.

enable_seccomp.label: Enable Seccomp
enable_seccomp.description: Whether sandbox-executor-manager starts containers with seccomp enabled.

max_memory.label: Max Memory
max_memory.description: Memory limit applied to each sandbox container. Common format: 256m or 1g.

container_network.label: Container Network
container_network.description: Docker network attached to sandbox containers. Defaults to 'none' (no external network access); set to 'bridge' only if sandboxed code needs outbound network.

sandbox_timeout.label: Sandbox Timeout
sandbox_timeout.description: Executor-manager container timeout for each sandbox run. Common format: 10s or 1m.

host.label: SSH Host
host.description: Remote host that will execute generated code.

port.label: SSH Port
port.description: SSH port on the remote host.

username.label: SSH Username
username.description: Username used to connect to the remote host.

password.label: SSH Password
password.placeholder: Optional when using a private key

private_key.label: SSH Private Key
private_key.placeholder: Paste PEM content or enter a local file path
private_key.description: Private key PEM content or a readable private key path on the RAGFlow host.

passphrase.label: Private Key Passphrase
passphrase.description: Passphrase for the private key if it is encrypted.

known_hosts.label: SSH known_hosts File
known_hosts.description: Path to an OpenSSH-format known_hosts file used to verify the remote host's key. When set, the file is loaded on top of the system host keys (~/.ssh/known_hosts). When unset, only system keys are used and unknown hosts are rejected.

python_bin.label: Python Binary
python_bin.description: Python executable used for remote code execution.

node_bin.label: Node.js Binary
node_bin.description: Node.js executable used for remote JavaScript execution.

work_dir.label: Remote Workspace Root
work_dir.description: Writable remote directory used to create a temporary workspace.

timeout.label: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Maximum SSH execution time for a single run.

max_output_bytes.label: Max Output Bytes
max_output_bytes.description: Maximum combined stdout and stderr size.

max_artifacts.label: Max Artifacts
max_artifacts.description: Maximum number of files collected from the remote artifacts directory.

max_artifact_bytes.label: Max Artifact Bytes
max_artifact_bytes.description: Maximum size of a single artifact file in bytes.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: Aliyun primary account ID, required for API calls

region.label: Region
region.description: Aliyun region for Code Interpreter service

template_name.label: Template Name
template_name.description: Optional sandbox template name for pre-configured environments

timeout.label: Execution Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Code execution timeout (max 30 seconds - hard limit)

timeout.label: Request Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: API request timeout for code execution

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.description: Tenki API key. Create one at https://app.tenki.cloud under API Keys.

base_url.label: API Endpoint
base_url.description: Override the Tenki API endpoint. Leave empty for the default.

image.label: Sandbox Image
image.description: Base image for sandboxes. Empty uses the Tenki default image (includes python3 and node).

allow_outbound.label: Allow Outbound Network
allow_outbound.description: Security-relevant. Disabled by default so sandboxed code has no network access. Enable it to let code make outbound connections (e.g. to install packages).

timeout.label: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Maximum execution time for a single run.

max_lifetime.label: Max Sandbox Lifetime (seconds)
max_lifetime.description: Tenki reclaims a sandbox after this, guarding against leaks if the run is interrupted.

cpu_cores.label: vCPU Cores
cpu_cores.description: vCPU per sandbox. 0 uses the Tenki default.

memory_mb.label: Memory (MB)
memory_mb.description: Memory per sandbox in MB. 0 uses the Tenki default.

disk_size_gb.label: Disk Size (GB)
disk_size_gb.description: Disk size per sandbox in GB. 0 uses the Tenki default.

max_output_bytes.label: Max Output Bytes
max_output_bytes.description: Maximum combined stdout and stderr size.

max_artifacts.label: Max Artifacts
max_artifacts.description: Maximum number of files collected from the sandbox artifacts directory.

max_artifact_bytes.label: Max Artifact Bytes
max_artifact_bytes.description: Maximum size of a single artifact file in bytes.

region.label: Region
region.description: UCloud Agent Sandbox region, for example cn-wlcb or us-ca.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Override the sandbox domain. Leave empty to derive it from Region.

api_url.label: API URL
api_url.description: Override the UCloud Agent Sandbox control-plane API URL.

template.label: Template
template.description: Sandbox template. The base template includes Python and Node.js.

allow_internet_access.label: Allow Internet Access
allow_internet_access.description: Allow sandboxed code to access the internet. Disabled by default.

insecure_http.label: Use Insecure HTTP
insecure_http.description: Use HTTP instead of HTTPS. Enable only for trusted private deployments.
